summary: Plymouth's 70-ft Pine Hill fire tower, built 1966 to replace the Manomet Hill tower; standing, unstaffed at a 2014 visit, with directions not signed.

visit.trail_note: NHLR 2014 visit report: no NHLR sign posted, and directions to the tower are not signed.

facts.agency: Massachusetts Bureau of Forest Fire Control (per NHLR)

events.note: Town of Plymouth operated a 90-ft iron fire tower on Billington Hill (predecessor tower, not this structure).
State takes over fire detection and builds a new tower on Reservoir Hill (predecessor).
Replacement 48-ft tower relocated to Telegraph Hill; served until 1942 (predecessor).

60-ft steel tower put up on Manomet Hill. NHLR says a new tower was constructed there that year; FFLOS says the steel tower was relocated from Pelham. Duties transferred from Telegraph Hill. Served until about 1966.
Current 70-ft tower with a 10x10-ft wooden cab built on Pine Hill. The Manomet Hill tower was discontinued and its duties moved here.
March 27, 2014 visit report: condition good (wood, stairs, glass OK); not staffed; no NHLR sign; directions not signed.

corrections.why: FFLOS US 1548 is the former Manomet Hill site, where the 1942-1966 tower stood. The standing Pine Hill tower is the NHLR entry, US 538, MA 5.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1966 for the Pine Hill tower, and the Forest Lookouts and FFLOS pages agree on about 1966 for the move. The story uses 1966. See notes for a 1969 date from a social-media snippet that was not read.
The register says a new tower was constructed on Manomet Hill in 1942. The former-sites record says the 60-ft steel tower was relocated from Pelham. The story reports both.

The brief's coordinates (41.9159, -70.59) match the NHLR Pine Hill entry. The FFLOS coordinates (41 deg 55.633', 70 deg 35.450') belong to the Manomet Hill site, about 1.3 km north, so they should not be used for the Pine Hill record.

notes_for_editor: The brief's record puts the FFLOS registration (US 1548, MA 55, March 27, 2014) on the Pine Hill tower, but that entry is the former Manomet Hill site; see corrections. Access is not recorded as a fact: no current access rules were found, and the 2014 NHLR visit report says directions are not signed. The story advises checking with the Bureau before any visit and does not tell readers to climb or not to climb. Build year: the NHLR and FFLOS say 1966. A search snippet from an FFLA Massachusetts Facebook post gives 1969 and says the tower is Plymouth's fifth; the page itself returned no text, so the date is not cited and should be checked if it matters. Mass.gov returned HTTP 403 and firelookout.org's Plymouth pages returned 404, so the state's current staffing and access status could not be checked. The brief's elevation_m (114.3) matches the NHLR 375 ft (114 m). The height of 21.3 m is the NHLR 70-ft figure for the current tower, which the brief did not list. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the story's 'record' wording is corrected to the register's 'activity', 'went up' is corrected to 'moved' for the 1939 Telegraph Hill tower, the 1942 new-tower versus relocated-from-Pelham disagreement is now stated, and the unsupported 'do not climb the tower without permission' line was removed because the NHLR page has no climbing or permission text.
